DRAFTING HOLE STILL OPEN: Rosznar's split is explicitly 'on net profits'; this one says 'on noble-channel sales only', where 'only' scopes which sales and leaves the BASE unstated. On an 80%-margin product that is 8,000 gross versus 6,720 net. Small now, not small if scope ever widens - fix the base wording at the next amendment.
